themes.description: Users repeatedly report that their fixed deposits (FDs) are not credited after purchase or maturity, and that withdrawal requests are delayed or fail altogether, often tied to KYC verification problems. These delays create confusion and frustration, eroding trust in the platform.
themes.business_impact: The delays are causing customers to abandon the app, resulting in churn, potential loss of FD revenue, negative word‑of‑mouth, and increased support tickets. The uncertainty also risks regulatory scrutiny for incomplete financial disclosures and could lead to financial penalties if delayed payouts are deemed non‑compliant.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Backend integration with banking partners for FD crediting and withdrawal processing is incomplete or incorrectly handling success/failure states. Concurrently, the KYC verification workflow is overly stringent or poorly timed, causing approvals to lag and triggering repeated re‑kyc prompts that break the FD booking flow.
themes.action_plan:
• 1) Conduct a full audit of the FD crediting and withdrawal APIs and fix any missing or mis‑configured endpoints
• 2) Implement idempotent, transactional handling for FD payouts and withdrawals to guarantee consistency
• 3) Simplify the KYC flow: move from video‑to‑document verification to a more reliable pre‑approval step, with clear status updates
• 4) Add automated alerts for pending transactions and a self‑service portal for customers to track status
• 5) Launch a dedicated support squad with 24/7 coverage for FD and withdrawal inquiries and provide proactive outreach for high‑value customers

themes.description: Users report that the app’s customer support channels are unresponsive, delayed, or redirect customers to unhelpful paths such as WhatsApp, leading to unresolved issues and frustration.
themes.business_impact: High customer churn, negative brand perception, potential financial loss due to refunds or unclaimed rewards, and regulatory scrutiny for inadequate support.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support system lacks adequate staffing, proper ticket routing, and escalation procedures, and the reliance on WhatsApp as a primary channel is ineffective for timely, documented resolution.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit current support workflow to identify bottlenecks
• Increase staffing and provide multi‑channel training (email, in‑app, phone)
• Implement automated ticket routing and SLAs
• Deploy a knowledge base and chatbot for common queries
• Monitor response metrics and iterate
• Escalate high‑priority issues to product owners

themes.name: [Negative] Performance & Load Issues

quotes.text: each screen takes 10-20 seconds to load. pathetic
one of the slowest and useless app very disappointed
app very slow not working properly

themes.description: Users report that the application takes excessive time to load screens and frequently lags, leading to frustration and inability to use the app effectively.
themes.business_impact: The slow performance causes immediate drop in user engagement, increasing uninstall rates by a measurable percentage and degrading overall app rating, which can reduce future downloads and revenue.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Likely suboptimal rendering and resource handling in the front-end code, coupled with inefficient data fetching and heavy assets, causing UI thread blocking and memory pressure.
themes.action_plan:
• Profile and optimize rendering pipeline
• Reduce image and asset sizes
• Implement lazy loading for non-critical resources
• Refactor heavy JavaScript logic to Web Workers
• Optimize API calls with caching and pagination
• Conduct performance regression tests before releases
